battle: Stone remembers every wound. Shall we add yours?
You stand between me and my purpose. Move.
commander: My blades answer to no one else.
The mountain moves at my command.
death: My work is not yet finished.
victory: Your defiance broke before my blades.
The stone stands. You do not.
defeat: You have won this battle. Remember that distinction.
A broken blade can be forged again.

battle: Do try to present an interesting problem.
Your strategy has several obvious flaws. Proceed.
commander: Allow me to demonstrate superior reasoning.
victory: The conclusion was never in doubt.
Your failure has confirmed my hypothesis.
defeat: An anomaly worth investigating. Nothing more.
I shall account for that variable next time.

battle: I have outlived far greater threats than you.
Even your courage has a short lifespan.
commander: My patience has finally run dry.
Kneel, while you still have the strength.
death: You mistake this wound for an ending.
victory: Another brief life, spent so carelessly.
In the end, even defiance falls silent.
defeat: Savor this victory. It will not last.
You have earned my attention. Regrettably.

battle: Take your time. I have already borrowed some.
Let us see what you do with this moment.
commander: I believe this is my moment.
death: I may need a moment to recover.
victory: You rushed. That makes all the difference.
A little foresight goes a very long way.
defeat: Well played. Even I cannot foresee everything.
That was your moment. You used it well.

battle: You trespass beneath the wings of a queen.
My brood will darken your last sunrise.
commander: Let every wing answer its queen!
The skies belong to my brood.
death: My brood will remember this wound.
You have not silenced the sky.
victory: Ashes are all that remain of your challenge.
No crown is won by challenging mine.
defeat: My wings may falter. My brood endures.
You have wounded a queen. Remember the cost.

battle: Hope you brought a plan that survives fire!
Ready? Because I am done holding back!
commander: My turn to turn up the heat!
Nobody gets to put out my spark!
death: Still got a little fire left.
victory: Whew! That is what I call a warmup!
Next time, try something less flammable!
defeat: Okay, you got me. That was pretty good.
Fine, you win. I am still burning bright!
